data.name: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
data.detailed_description:
The cardboard trip is not over.

Cars and Guns: Paper Parts is a visceral, surreal vehicular action game with a soulslike heart. Everything here is made of cardboard, tape, and forgotten stories. You are a driver made of scraps, trying to stay whole in a world that wants to recycle you.

Fifteen years ago, Cars and Guns 3D introduced a strange, cardboard world of motorized mayhem. Later, NO THING took you on a monochromatic, surreal journey to the Office of the Future. Now, the paths merge. The road leads to The Garage of the Queen of Ice.

Key Features:

  • The Economy of Scrap: Every enemy you shred drops crumpled cardboard dollars. Collect them to rebuild your vehicle, but beware: when you burn out, your fortune stays on the road as a smoldering pile of trash.

  • Folded Reality: Experience a world where damage means tears and creases. Your car isn't just a health bar. It’s a physical, paper object that falls apart piece by piece.

  • The Garage of the Queen of Ice: A direct, surreal self-parody of the NO THING mythos. This is your sanctuary in the void. A palace of cardboard where paper parts are integrated into something more than just a machine.

  • Analog Soul: No AI, just ink and imagination. A tactile return to the handmade, experimental roots of Evil Indie Games.

The Queen of Ice is waiting in her garage. Will you reach her before you tear apart?

data.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.
